commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.

90+4' Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Florent Batta with no other option than to blow for a foul.
90+2' Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
90+1' Here comes a substitution. Jean N'Guessan (Metz) is brought on as a substitute for Lamine Camara.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Laszlo Boloni has decided to substitute Kevin Van Den Kerkhof and he is replaced by Malick Mbaye (Metz).
87' A cross from Joel Asoro (Metz) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

85' 3 - 1 Goal! Great link up play between Joel Asoro (Metz) and Kevin Van Den Kerkhof gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the right side of the goal. 3:1.
84' The substitution is prepared. Kevin N'Doram (Metz) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ablie Jallow.
84' Laszlo Boloni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Joel Asoro (Metz) replacing Pape Diallo.
82' Jaouen Hadjam (Nantes) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
81' Here's the change. Samuel Moutoussamy leaves the pitch and Adson (Nantes) comes on as a substitute.
80' Eray Comert (Nantes) makes a strong challenge and Florent Batta blows for a foul.
80' Florent Mollet (Nantes) takes the corner which is cleared.
79' Matthis Abline (Nantes) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Nantes will take a corner kick.

76' Florent Mollet (Nantes) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball sails well over the bar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Metz.
75' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) has a sight of goal and shoots from distance, but Alban Lafont is equal to it.
72' Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) flashes a header well wide of the left post following a lofted pass into the centre of the box. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
70' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nantes.
68' Christophe Herelle is being substituted because of an injury. Laszlo Boloni sends Fali Cande (Metz) on the pitch.
65' Christophe Herelle (Metz) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
62' Moses Simon (Nantes) rises above the defence and heads a precise cross towards the left post. His effort, however, is blocked by Alexandre Oukidja, who pulls off a stunning save!
62' Eray Comert (Nantes) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Florent Batta blows for a foul.
61' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Nantes.
60' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jaouen Hadjam (Nantes) comes onto the pitch so that Quentin Merlin can be given a rest.
58' Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Metz.
58' Florent Mollet (Nantes) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
56' Crossbar! Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) picks up a precise pass and produces a bullet of a strike from distance that smashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal.
54' Substitution. Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Marcus Coco walks off.
54' Here is a change. Nicolas Pallois is going off and Pierre Aristouy gives the last tactical orders to Eray Comert (Nantes).
54' The referee allows time for a substitution. Mostafa Mohamed will be replaced by Matthis Abline (Nantes).
52' Alban Lafont displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
51' A pass by Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
50' Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
49' Nantes fail to score from a corner as Alexandre Oukidja (Metz) leaps to collect the ball.
48' Matthieu Udol (Metz) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
47' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Florent Batta has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Marcus Coco (Nantes) is penalised for a foul. Florent Batta had a clear view and blows his whistle.
45+2' The game is interrupted as Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes) is flagged offside.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.

45' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Marcus Coco (Nantes) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
44' Ablie Jallow (Metz) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
42' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.

40' Alexandre Oukidja doesn't have to worry about this one. Moses Simon plays a pass into the feet of Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Metz.
38' The resulting corner from Lamine Camara (Metz) comes to nothing.
38' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag and Metz will take a corner.
36' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) commits a foul and Florent Batta immediately signals a free kick.
34' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
32' Moses Simon (Nantes) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Alexandre Oukidja stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
31' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
28' 2 - 1 Goal! Ablie Jallow plays a long ball to Simon Elisor (Metz), who cuts inside and unleashes a screamer into the bottom right corner. The keeper had no chance. Superb strike! 2:1.
26' Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Florent Batta blows his whistle for a foul.
24' Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
23' Matthieu Udol (Metz) serves up a nice cross, but Alban Lafont punches the ball away.
21' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Florent Mollet (Nantes).
18' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
16' The resulting set piece from Metz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
15' Maxime Colin (Metz) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
12' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Nicolas Pallois plays it into the box, and Moses Simon (Nantes) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the back of the net. 1:1.
12' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Florent Batta wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
12' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Moses Simon (Nantes) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
10' Pape Diallo (Metz) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
8' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
5' Pape Diallo (Metz) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alban Lafont, who smothers the ball.
3' 1 - 0 Matthieu Udol plays a terrific cross over to Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz), who finds some space inside the box and puts the ball into the back of the net.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Nantes will take the kick-off.
Florent Batta is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
